description: Zero‑dependency, ultra‑fast Node.js framework with built‑in TypeScript, edge‑ready routing, and out‑of‑the‑box security – the Express‑style API you love, without the bloat.
npm_trending_strategy: Leverage the rise of edge‑computing and serverless platforms by emphasizing native compatibility with Cloudflare Workers, Bun, and Deno. Highlight the built‑in TypeScript compiler and zero‑dependency model as a cost‑saving, performance‑first alternative to Express and Fastify. Use the "express‑style" API in marketing copy to capture existing familiarity while showcasing unique features like automatic request sanitization, built‑in rate‑limiting, and compile‑time route validation—keywords that align with 2026 search trends (AI‑ready, reactive, observable).
download_hooks: Developers pick Yantravese for its single‑file install: no extra npm packages, instant start‑up, and a familiar Express‑style API that drops straight into production.
Performance angle: Benchmarks show sub‑millisecond routing latency on edge runtimes and up to 3× faster throughput than Fastify in serverless cold‑start scenarios.

Developer experience angle: Built‑in TypeScript, automatic type‑safe route definitions, and out‑of‑the‑box security (CSRF, XSS, rate limiting) let you ship secure APIs without writing extra middleware.
